description: This file defines a report parser class for purchase order reports in Odoo, including methods to retrieve tax information and product codes.

classes.name: order
classes.description: A report parser class for purchase order reports, providing methods to fetch tax details and product codes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context and updates local context with utility functions.

methods.name: _get_line_tax
methods.description: Retrieves tax names associated with a specific order line.

methods.name: _get_tax
methods.description: Calculates tax details for a given purchase order, including base amount and tax amount.

methods.name: _get_product_code
methods.description: Fetches the product code for a given product and partner.
